notes.title: Coming up in 2.0!
notes.notes: [p]Alright everyone! I've been talking about a major update, but realized I haven't shared anything on Steam. So now it's your turn to see what I've been up to![/p][p][/p][p][b]Please note, that this is still in development and some things might be different when the update releases![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2] [u][b]The BIG 2.0[/b][/u][/h2][p]In 2.0 Tiny Kings will be different visually as well as offering better gameplay and goals. Changing the visual style of Tiny Kings was a very hard decision to make, but the Team and I believe its for the better. It will allow us to add more content and expand the game in ways that would have not been possible before. An added bonus is that your kingdom will now look even tinier!![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478747/4fdd6e9b3bf3ce58e3e3d6a7176d447838a9117d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Villages Aren't Confusing Anymore![/b][/h3][p]Place a house, select the house, select the job.... AGGHHHH! Yeah, it wasn't the best resource gathering system to have. In 2.0 this will all change. Houses will now be a village with multiple villagers at your disposal. You will then be able to draw a road connecting your village to the resources you'd like to collect! Plain and simple, much better!![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478747/95215ebb721a6405010871e3f3a8c484829e42b9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Gameplay![/b][/h3][p]One of the bigger changes in 2.0 will be the gameplay. Instead of just waiting for your impending doom, trying to last as long as you can while the enemy gets stronger and stronger, you'll be able to FIGHT BACK! Thant's right, YOU will now have the power to show those pesky barbarians who's boss. Tiny Kings will also be leaning more towards RTS style, rather than tower defense.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478747/3a2b8857aa27a1c827f32962d351491a4c641683.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Extra Stuff in 2.0![/b][/h3][p]A lot of stuff in 2.0 is a complete rework of the old systems to make them feel better while playing. There's more feedback when building, the world generates faster, more customization options, improvements on the leaderboards, and the list goes on. With all these reworks you should also see WAY less crashes and bugs. I'm really sorry for releasing with that many bugs![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]When Will This Amazing Update Release!?[/b][/h3][p]We are just a two man band, and I'm the only programmer, SO! I'm hoping that either the full update or an open beta will be released in the next month, but bugs and such always find me. So, as much as I hope to get something to you guys in the next month, I can't promise anything.[/p][p][/p][p]I WILL be posting development progress of 2.0 as new features and milestones are released now that I have made the big announcement. Thank you to everyone how has purchased and supported Tiny Kings. It really means a lot, especially with the amount of bugs found in 1.0. I am truly sorry for the state I released Tiny Kings in, and I can't wait for you all to play the Tiny Kings you deserve. [/p][p][/p][p] - Tony[/p]

notes.title: Pricing drop!
notes.notes: [h1][b]What's up everyone![/b][/h1][p][/p][p][b]I have decided to lower the price of Tiny Kings after realizing that the previous set price was too high for the amount of bug I started finding. I am very sorry for the lack of quality in the initial EA release and not changing the price earlier. I'm still learning the ropes of launching a game, but I'll get used to it![/b] [/p][p][/p][h2][b]On a positive note![/b][/h2][p][b]I am continuing to work on a MAJOR update to Tiny Kings that will be bringing lots of great changes to gameplay, as well as fix up all those pesky bugs. Don't expect the update to come out at lighting speed (I am the only programmer on our very small team), but I can't wait for you all to try it![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]If you have purchased Tiny Kings before the price change:  [/b][b][i]July 19, 9:00 p.m EST [/i][/b][b]let me know if you would like a compensation. If it is something most people would like, I will absolutely look into making that happen! You can let me know in the Discord Server, Steam Groups, or by commenting on this post.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, that's all for this announcement! Hope you all have a good day, see you in the next announcement! [/p]

notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! Here are the patch notes for today.[/p][list][*][p]Implemented Time Warp: You can now speed up or slow down time![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cloud fade: All clouds trying to block your view now fade, not just one![/p][/*][*][p]Updated Movement: Enemy movement should no longer behave oddly when at lower framerates![/p][/*][/list]

notes.notes: [p]Hey everybody! Fixed some bugs and made some balance changes in this patch.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Stopped enemy bodies from stretching most of the time[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the amount of food given from farms and barns[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the random spawn gap dramatically[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly decreased difficulty curve[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We are working on a pretty big gameplay update, so minor bugs fixes and changes will be rolled out slower.  [/p]

notes.title: In-game Resource Update and Thank you
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p][b]We’ve got a two announcements to share today as we approach release day![/b][/p][p][/p][p]In play testing we have found that Stone and Wood resources felt clunky and incomplete. We feel that in its current state it overcomplicates the game. We apologize for such late notice of this, but we don’t want to release an incomplete feature. Do not worry though, as we plan to bring Stone and Wood back in a later update. As you can see by this amazing graph, we predict Tiny Kings’ awesomeness level to increase as more updates are pushed out![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45478747/370714fa238628f5afff7349658871a95c5d207b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The second announcement is something I am very grateful for.
Tiny Kings has over [b]100 wishlists[/b]! I want to thank you for all the support, it really means a lot. From humble beginnings as a game-jam game to a full release on Steam. Creating and expanding Tiny Kings had been a great journey! On behalf of the team, I thank you all for your support and can’t wait to see your kingdoms and hear your feedback.[/p]

notes.title: Localization Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I have a small announcement today about in-game localization. After much thought, I will be removing Spanish as a supported language for in-game text. This is only temporary and Spanish will be added after the [i]initial[/i] release of the game. This will allow me to focus my time on more important features.

I apologize for any inconvenience this will cause.
